detail: Target interface and environment absent (F-07); no endpoint or UI interaction can be supplied.
Actual acceptance, decision and status observation mechanisms/locators absent (F-01,F-07).
No fixtures or means to create fresh documents and set rebate conditions supplied (F-07).
Cleanup obligations/permissions absent; do not assume deletion is safe or no cleanup is necessary (F-07).
Actor and authorization mechanics absent; no inferred role restrictions or credential tests (F-07).
Error signal/code/message unspecified (F-01,F-06); only policy invalidity or DRAFT state invariant can be asserted.
No persisted-data side-effect rule (F-06). Do not assert no writes, no audit event, or no other effects.

F-06 leaves other pairs unspecified. F-03 terminal prohibits valid outgoing state transitions, but does not establish error, ignored-event or retry/idempotency behavior. No closed-world denials added.

F-01 excludes nonintegers at policy level. Representation/coercion rules for 2.0, string 2, boolean, null or omitted input need an interface contract; fractional 2.5 is outside strict integer domain. Helper integer grid does not cover this obligation.
F-07 supplies no workload, target, duration or thresholds; these dimensions are deferred, no passing judgement available.
Source facts explicitly draft-only. This artifact is AGENT_REVIEW_ONLY; formal case baseline remains unapproved.
